subject: Request: NovaRun pilot stipend + 6-week extension
messages:
From: Anna Mantle <anna@novorun.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novorun.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot extension + stipend for NovaRun cohort

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the run earlier this month — the Redwood demo helped us validate latency on our ingestion pipeline. We're in the middle of our accelerator cohort and need to extend the pilot window while we complete two technical milestones. Can Redwood approve a 6-week extension and a small stipend (we're asking for $5k in platform credits) to cover extra token usage for our demo builds?

Attached is a short one-pager on the milestones and why the extra run time will impact our go-to-market demo. We can sign a simple SOW and accept milestone-based credit disbursement. Procurement is looped in for contract questions (procurement@novorun.com).

Quick answers we'd need from you to move forward:
- Can credits be escrowed and disbursed after each milestone?
- Any requirements for SOC2 evidence or security questionnaire?
- Typical turnaround time for a pilot extension and SOW?

Appreciate your help — we are demoing to a lead investor in late July and need the runway.

Best,
Anna Mantle
Co-founder | NovaRun
anna@novorun.com

Thanks Anna — and congrats on the progress.

High level: we typically support pilot extensions and milestone-based credits for accelerator partners, but we have a short checklist before we can finalize approval:
- Confirm milestone acceptance criteria and simple SOW (one page OK)
- Security evidence: SOC2 letter / short questionnaire (we can fast-track)
- Billing & PO expectations (do you need an invoice now or after milestones?)
- Who will own the onboarding work internally at NovaRun?

Can you send the milestone list with expected dates and point-of-contact? I've cc'ed Karthik and Laura to help with commercial terms and approvals. If you want, we can do a 30-minute call tomorrow to align.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Mantle <anna@novorun.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension + stipend for NovaRun cohort

Hi Neha,

Thanks — attached is a proposed 3-milestone plan with dates and acceptance criteria. We plan to:
1) Integrate Redwood inference into our real-time scoring pipeline (by 2027-06-21) — acceptance = 95% of test traffic processing at <120ms P95.
2) Build investor-facing demo flows (by 2027-07-05) — acceptance = demo run without errors for 10 consecutive tests.
3) Prepare performance runbook and infra handoff (by 2027-07-20) — acceptance = runbook and automation to spin a staging env.

Procurement asked for the SOC2 letter and a draft SOW; attaching both. Procurement is okay with milestone invoicing as long as credits are capped and documented in the SOW.

Attachment: NovaRun_SOW_v0.2.docx (draft SOW), SOC2_letter.pdf

Let us know if anything looks off and we can jump on a call.

—Anna

Quick read from the commercial side: I think this is a good candidate for an exception. Recommendation:
- Approve: 6-week extension (2027-06-14 -> 2027-07-26)
- Approve: $5,000 in credits, released in two tranches: $2,500 after milestone 1 pass, $2,500 after milestone 2 pass; final milestone is handoff verification (no credits attached).
- Conditions: sign SOW v0.2 with milestone schedule + procurement PO or email confirmation.
- Ask: require SOC2_letter on file (they provided it) and require the standard pilot T&Cs (I can attach a one-page schedule).

Hi Anna & procurement team,

Good news — we've approved the requested extension and pilot stipend under the terms below:
- Extension: 6 weeks (through 2027-07-26)
- Credits: $5,000 in platform credits, paid in two tranches tied to milestone 1 and milestone 2 (details below)
- Condition: Signed SOW (attached), procurement PO or email header confirmation, and SOC2 letter on file.

Next steps for execution:
1) I've attached the draft SOW (NovaRun_SOW_v0.2.docx) — please review and confirm any changes.
